name: Health & Life Co., Ltd.
summary: Health & Life Co., Ltd. is a global provider of medical devices. Established in 1996 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, the company specializes in developing and distributing solutions for critical health sectors, including cardiovascular health, in-vitro diagnostics, and respiratory care. Its diverse product line encompasses advanced vibrating mesh nebulizers, blood pressure monitoring systems, infrared thermometers, and various hearing aid technologies.
